contract: prototype.json: UTF-8, <=1MiB, no duplicate JSON keys, top-level keys exactly schema_version/retention/counterexamples/incidents
counterexamples: exactly 4 items, ids frozen to the v1 set (author-role-spoof, outer-pass-inner-fail, cross-missing-evidence, unasserted-promotion); replaced/missing ids -> exit 2
red receipt must record nonzero exit_code; green receipt must record exit_code 0
receipt: argv 1..16 strings, exit_code int -128..255, stdout/stderr sha256 64 lowercase hex
incidents <=1024, unique id, counterexample must reference existing id, revision string, green receipt only
boundary: retention.repo must be absolute path or remote URL (http://, https://, git@); relative rejected (exit 2)
absolute retention.repo inside this repository -> exit 1
no directory named retention anywhere in the working repo tree (excluding .git) -> else exit 1
read_only: check never executes argv recorded in the document
no identity, no approval, no stage write
cli: check PROTOTYPE prints one JSON verdict

rollback: delete capabilities/maintenance_prototype/ directory; CI capability-tests auto-shrinks
tests: tests/test_check.py (contract, boundary, real red/green re-execution of example receipts)
